caption: Trial banner and initial member allowance.
Free active plan and paid offers.
Pro checkout for 500 subscribers at $9 a month, with the payment due on November 29; we stopped here without adding a payment method.
Subscription overview on the trial: plan 1K at $0 a month, 0 out of 1,000 members, no payment methods added and the banner 'Your free trial expires in 30 days'.
A new team member form opens with the Admin role selected; Viewer is among the other roles. We did not save it; the email address and password are hidden.
The API key page is available in the trial and notes that the key has full access to the account; the key itself is hidden.
Opt-in settings for a new list: Single opt-in is selected by default, so our imported test members got no confirmation email.
Custom field types and created fields.
CSV import mapping: subscription_state and attachment stay on 'Map to...' because there is no matching field; nine of our eleven columns were mapped. The list ID is hidden.
Both made-up members after the import, shown as Active although the subscription_state column was not mapped; the list ID is hidden.
First member custom code and normalized amount.
The first test member's record after the import: free text, record date 2026-10-24, and the tags kept as plain text 'aibm-test|alpha' rather than native tags.
The export is not a direct download: Moosend says it will be sent by email when finished; the email address and list ID are hidden.
After importing the changed file again with 'Add or update', the second member's free text reads 'AIBM-002 UPDATED'; the match was on email and no duplicate appeared.
